meta.source: DESIGN.md v2 + tokens/tokens.json v2 + design-sheet-layl-dark.html + design-sheet-nahar-light.html. Values identical to tokens/tokens.json in the repo; this copy adds the font files and type samples the page needs.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background (home, journal, calendar, settings). Light = the cream of the app icon.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Onboarding and reflection background — the only grounds that carry the star lattice.

tokens.name: ground-deepest
tokens.usage: Reflection step «التعمّق» only.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Cards. Dark = white 6% over ground + backdrop blur 20; light = white 60% over ground + blur 24. 1px hairline, radius-card, shadow-card.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab bar, toast, filled chip. Blur 24, shadow-raised.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Quran block, search field, setting rows, prompt card, text areas. No shadow.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders, dividers, ThreadProgress track, disabled button fill, toggle-off track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text on every ground and glass. 15.4:1 dark · 13.8:1 light on ground.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on grounds and glass. 10.5:1 dark · 9.2:1 light.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, timestamps, placeholders, surah references on grounds and glass. 8.3:1 dark · 5.6:1 light.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The ONLY highlighted text colour: ayah text (dark only), active tab, chip text, text buttons, wordmark (dark). Dark = gold-bright, light = terracotta-ink (5.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marks and outlines: thread rule + dot, ThreadProgress fill, chip outlines, calendar «done» dots, scholar attribution, «ح» avatar ring. Dark = gold-deep, light = terracotta. In light never text under 24px (4.0:1) — the 12px scholar attribution is the source's own exception.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill (accent at 18% dark / 14% light) under accent-text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fills only: primary button, today ring, toggle-on, numbered prompt badge. White label ≥18px/600 (4.3:1 dark · 4.7:1 light). Never running text.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button (white label 5.3:1 · 7.0:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and knob colour on primary fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete only, always with the word «حذف». 6.1:1 on glass dark · 5.4:1 light.

tokens.name: quran-text
tokens.usage: Ayah text in Amiri Quran inside ﴿ ﴾: gold-bright on dark, ink on light.

tokens.name: quran-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the Quran block and share-card ayah card (accent at 28% / 35%).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backing behind a chip that sits on the star lattice.

tokens.name: lattice-stroke
tokens.usage: Star-lattice stroke (text at 5%). Onboarding and reflection only.

tokens.name: cone
tokens.usage: Dark: spotlight radial wash behind «نعمة اليوم», ≤6%. Light: two soft blobs of ground-deepest at 60%, blur ≈120, instead of the cone.

tokens.name: icon-ground
tokens.usage: App-icon artwork only (brown / cream). Never a UI surface.

tokens.name: icon-thread
tokens.usage: Wordmark thread on the app icon. Icon artwork only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand word; thread below it. accent-text in dark, text in light.

styles.name: blessing-title
styles.usage: Title of a blessing on home, reflection and share cards.

styles.name: hadith
styles.sample: «أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ»
styles.usage: Hadith and du'a inside « », colour text.

styles.name: ayah
styles.usage: Quran (Uthmani) only, always inside ﴿ ﴾, colour quran-text. Never any other use.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label — never smaller (on-primary on primary is large-text contrast only).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: نافذتك إلى الحياة، بها تبصر النور.

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: Secondary copy, compact buttons, empty states.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Base step.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: page-inset
tokens.usage: Horizontal page margin.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact).

tokens.name: card-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding (roomy).

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; compact button height.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary button height.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, share-card inner card.

tokens.name: radius-dialog-button
tokens.usage: Buttons inside dialogs and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, setting rows, Quran block, top bar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, toasts, avatar, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab bar.

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of glass-card (dark); light uses 24.

tokens.name: blur-raised
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of glass-raised.

tokens.name: micro
tokens.usage: easeOut — toggles, presses.

tokens.name: standard
tokens.usage: easeOutCubic — navigation, sheets.

tokens.name: sentence
tokens.usage: Reflection sentence fade-in.

tokens.name: ambience
tokens.usage: easeInOutCubic — reflection ambience shift (800ms with reduced motion).

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Lucide icons.

tokens.name: icon-size-tab
tokens.usage: Tab-bar icons.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide strokeWidth.

tokens.name: scale-normal
tokens.usage: عادي — default user text size.

tokens.name: scale-large
tokens.usage: كبير — multiplies the whole ramp; line heights preserved.

tokens.name: scale-larger
tokens.usage: أكبر.
